input_messages.content: Hello, I’m having some trouble with my mobile data. It either stops working or is very slow, and I really need it to be excellent. I’m not very good with technology, so I’d appreciate some help getting it fixed. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I rely on my mobile internet. Can you help me get the best speed possible?
My name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002. I hope that’s enough to get started. What do I need to do next?

The problem seems to happen everywhere, not just in one place. Sometimes the internet works, but it’s often very slow or just stops working completely. Right now, I think I have some mobile data, but it’s not reliable at all. What should I do next?

Looking at the top of my screen, I see an airplane icon (like a little plane) and the battery is at 80%. I don’t see anything about signal bars or network type. What does this mean? Is that bad for my internet?

Okay, I turned off Airplane Mode. Now I see one bar for signal, it says 2G, and there’s something that looks like a circle with a line through it (I think it means data is disabled). The battery is still at 80%. What should I do now?

I turned on mobile data. Now I still see just one bar for signal, it still says 2G, and the data icon looks like it’s on now. Is this going to help my internet speed? It still says 2G, which doesn’t sound very fast. What should I do next?

Okay, I changed the setting to prefer 4G/5G. Now at the top of my screen, I see four bars for signal, it says 5G, and the data icon is still on. That looks much better! Is there anything else I need to do to make sure my internet speed is excellent?
Oh, I tried to check my internet speed, but it says there’s no connection. Even though it shows 5G and full bars, it seems like the internet still isn’t working. What should I do now?

I followed your instructions and reset the APN settings, then restarted my phone. Unfortunately, I still can’t get any internet connection—when I try to check the speed, it says there’s no connection. The status bar still shows 5G, four bars, and data is enabled. What should I do now?

I checked, and Data Saver mode is already turned off. I still can’t get any internet connection, even though it shows 5G and full bars. What else can I try? I really need excellent internet speed on my phone.

I checked, and there’s no VPN turned on. I also restarted my phone again, but I still can’t get any internet connection. The status bar still shows 5G, four bars, and data is enabled, but the speed test keeps saying there’s no connection. I’m starting to get a bit frustrated—why isn’t this working? What else can I do to get excellent internet speed?
Alright, I’ll wait. Thank you for your help so far—I really hope the next person can get my internet working at an excellent speed.

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hello, I’m having some trouble with my mobile data. It either stops working or is very slow, and I really need it to be excellent. I’m not very good with technology, so I’d appreciate some help getting it fixed. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I rely on my mobile internet. Can you help me get the best speed possible?

I can help you troubleshoot and improve your mobile data speed. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your account,
- Your full name and date of birth,
- Or your customer ID (if you know it)?

Once I have this information, I can check your line and guide you through the steps to improve your mobile data speed.
My name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002. I hope that’s enough to get started. What do I need to do next?

Thank you for providing your information. I have identified your account. To help you get the best possible mobile data speed, I’ll guide you through a few steps to diagnose and improve your connection.

First, could you please tell me:
- Are you experiencing this issue everywhere, or only in certain locations?
- Is the problem constant, or does it come and go?
- Are you currently able to use any mobile data at all, or is it completely unavailable?

Once you let me know, I’ll walk you through some quick checks and fixes on your phone to improve your data speed.

The problem seems to happen everywhere, not just in one place. Sometimes the internet works, but it’s often very slow or just stops working completely. Right now, I think I have some mobile data, but it’s not reliable at all. What should I do next?

Thank you for the details. To help improve your mobile data speed, I’ll guide you through a few steps on your phone. These steps will help us check for common issues like network settings, data limits, and other possible causes.

Let’s start by checking your phone’s status bar for important indicators (like signal strength, network type, and whether mobile data is enabled). Please follow these instructions:

1. On your phone, look at the top of your screen (the status bar).
2. Tell me what icons you see there, especially:
   - Signal bars (how many bars, or if it says “No Signal”)
   - Network type (e.g., 5G, 4G, LTE, 3G, E)
   - Any airplane mode icon (✈️)
   - Any data-related icons (like “Data Saver” or “Data Disabled”)

If you’re not sure, you can also describe what you see, and I’ll help interpret it. Once I have this information, I’ll guide you through the next steps to improve your mobile data speed.
Status Bar: ✈️ Airplane Mode | 🔋 80%

Looking at the top of my screen, I see an airplane icon (like a little plane) and the battery is at 80%. I don’t see anything about signal bars or network type. What does this mean? Is that bad for my internet?

The airplane icon means that Airplane Mode is turned ON. When Airplane Mode is enabled, all wireless connections—including mobile data and cellular service—are turned off. This is why you’re not seeing any signal bars or network type, and it’s likely the main reason your mobile data isn’t working reliably.

To fix this, you need to turn Airplane Mode OFF. Here’s how you can do it:
1. Swipe down from the top of your screen to open the quick settings menu.
2. Look for the Airplane Mode icon (it looks like a small airplane).
3. Tap the Airplane Mode icon to turn it OFF. The icon should no longer be highlighted.

Once you’ve turned Airplane Mode off, check if your signal bars and network type (like 4G or 5G) appear at the top of your screen. Let me know what you see after turning off Airplane Mode, and we’ll continue troubleshooting if needed.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%

Okay, I turned off Airplane Mode. Now I see one bar for signal, it says 2G, and there’s something that looks like a circle with a line through it (I think it means data is disabled). The battery is still at 80%. What should I do now?

Thank you for the update. Here’s what your status means:
- One bar for signal: Weak signal strength.
- 2G: You’re connected to an older, much slower network type.
- Data disabled icon: Mobile data is currently turned off, so you can’t use the internet.

Let’s address these issues step by step:

1. Turn ON your mobile data:
   - Swipe down from the top of your screen to open the quick settings menu.
   - Look for the “Mobile Data” icon (it may look like two arrows or say “Data”).
   - Tap it to turn mobile data ON. The icon should become highlighted, and the “data disabled” symbol should disappear.

2. After turning on mobile data, check if your network type changes from 2G to something faster (like 4G or 5G), and if your signal bars improve.

Please let me know:
- If you were able to turn on mobile data,
- What network type you see now (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G, etc.),
- How many signal bars you have.

This will help me guide you to the next step for improving your speed.

Mobile Data is now ON.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%

I turned on mobile data. Now I still see just one bar for signal, it still says 2G, and the data icon looks like it’s on now. Is this going to help my internet speed? It still says 2G, which doesn’t sound very fast. What should I do next?

You are correct—2G is a very slow network and is not suitable for good internet speed. To improve your speed, we need to make sure your phone is set to prefer faster networks like 4G or 5G.

Please follow these steps on your phone:
1. Go to your phone’s Settings app.
2. Find and select “Network & Internet” or “Connections.”
3. Tap on “Mobile Network” or “Cellular Network.”
4. Look for an option called “Preferred network type” or “Network mode.”
5. Select the option that says “4G/5G preferred” or “LTE/4G/5G auto.”

After you change this setting, wait a few seconds and check the top of your screen again:
- Does the network type change from 2G to 4G, LTE, or 5G?
- Do your signal bars improve?

Let me know what you see after making this change, and I’ll help you with the next steps if needed.

Preferred Network Mode set to: 4g_5g_preferred
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%

Okay, I changed the setting to prefer 4G/5G. Now at the top of my screen, I see four bars for signal, it says 5G, and the data icon is still on. That looks much better! Is there anything else I need to do to make sure my internet speed is excellent?
Speed test failed: No Connection.
Oh, I tried to check my internet speed, but it says there’s no connection. Even though it shows 5G and full bars, it seems like the internet still isn’t working. What should I do now?

Thank you for letting me know. If your phone now shows 5G and full signal bars but you still have no internet connection, there may be an issue with your network settings, such as your APN (Access Point Name) configuration.

Let’s try resetting your APN settings to default, which often fixes this problem. After resetting, you’ll need to restart your phone for the changes to take effect.

Here’s what to do:
1. Go to your phone’s Settings app.
2. Tap on “Network & Internet” or “Connections.”
3. Select “Mobile Network.”
4. Tap on “Access Point Names” or “APN.”
5. Look for an option to “Reset to default” or “Reset settings” and select it.

After you reset your APN settings, please restart your phone.

Once your phone has restarted, try using your mobile internet again and let me know if it works. If you still have issues, please tell me what you see in your status bar (network type, signal bars, and any icons).

APN settings will reset at reboot.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%

Resetting APN settings...
Restarting network services...
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
